def prepare():
 import importlib.util
 from pathlib import Path
 build=Path('/home/matteius/experiments/glm-reconstruction-20261006/build-mhc-finish-v1')
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('qualified_mhc_finish_v1',build/'mhc_post_native.py')
 module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
 return {'native':module.NativeMhcPost(build,'glm_reconstruction_v77',finish_only=True),'wrap_post':module.wrap_post}

def validate(resources):
 import torch
 native=resources['native'];generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(7305)
 def reference(x,res,p,comb):
  return (torch.einsum('...ij,...ih->...jh',comb,res)+p*x.float().unsqueeze(1)).half().float()
 cases=0
 for dtype in (torch.float16,torch.float32):
  for rows in (1,2,8):
   x=torch.randn(rows,4096,generator=generator,dtype=dtype).npu()
   r=torch.randn(rows,4,4096,generator=generator).half().float().npu()
   p=torch.randn(rows,4,1,generator=generator).sigmoid().half().float().npu()
   comb=torch.randn(rows,4,4,generator=generator).softmax(-1).half().float().npu()
   torch.testing.assert_close(native(x,r,p,comb).cpu(),reference(x,r,p,comb).cpu(),rtol=0,atol=0)
   graph=torch.npu.NPUGraph()
   with torch.npu.graph(graph):result=native(x,r,p,comb)
   x.mul_(1.125);r.copy_((r*0.875).half().float());p.copy_((p*0.75).half().float());comb.copy_(comb.flip(-1).contiguous())
   graph.replay();torch.npu.synchronize()
   torch.testing.assert_close(result.cpu(),reference(x,r,p,comb).cpu(),rtol=0,atol=0)
   cases+=1
 x=torch.full((1,4096),1+2**-11+2**-22,dtype=torch.float32,device='npu')
 r=torch.zeros((1,4,4096),dtype=torch.float32,device='npu');r[:,0,:]=-0.5
 p=torch.ones((1,4,1),dtype=torch.float32,device='npu')
 comb=torch.zeros((1,4,4),dtype=torch.float32,device='npu');comb[:,0,:]=1
 expected=reference(x,r,p,comb).cpu()
 assert torch.equal(native(x,r,p,comb).cpu(),expected)
 assert not torch.equal(native(x.half(),r,p,comb).cpu(),expected)
 return {'passed':True,'cases':cases,'changed_all_inputs_graph_replay':True,'fp32_tie_input_preserved':True,'state_rounding':'fp16_in_fp32_storage','model_quality':'not_evaluated'}
